paper_facing_name: Hierarchical Move-Blocked Mixed-Integer MPC with Causal Domain Reduction

decisions: queued-job start block, rack, and IDC placement

resident_job_slots.growth: Per-method geometric growth to the next power of two when the visible causal queue exceeds the resident frontier
resident_job_slots.reuse: A grown model is reused for every later issue of that method; growth never drops or hides queued work

queued_dataset_residency.checkpoint_separation: The engineering checkpoint payload applies only to migration of an already-running job, never to queued-job placement

slow_master.circle_role: 16-face polyhedral stress epigraph for causal ranking; normalized planning stress may exceed one and Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS is the H0 grid-safety commit authority
slow_master.exact_forced_domain_rule: Skip the MILP only when every retained slow decision has exactly one feasible option

fast_recourse.solver: persistent continuous LP with a conservative 16-face inscribed circle model
fast_recourse.charge_discharge_exclusivity_recovery: If the relaxed continuous incumbent exceeds the frozen 1e-4 kW simultaneous charge/discharge gate, fix every five-minute dispatch direction from incumbent net power and re-solve all lexicographic priorities inside the original watchdog; never widen the gate or commit the relaxed incumbent.
exact_constraints: line P-Q inner-polygon stress epigraph with independent Euclidean objective audit
service-transformer P-Q inner-polygon stress epigraph with independent Euclidean objective audit
MESS PCS P-Q inner polygons with independent Euclidean-norm audit
fixed slow-decision GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, and deadline feasibility
fast_recourse.acceptance: Independent dimensionless stress-epigraph residual at the frozen scale-aware numerical tolerance, hard PCS headroom, no simultaneous charge/discharge, and downstream Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS H0 grid acceptance

lexicographic_objectives: min sum_h z_h * delta_t subject to priority 1
min secondary actuation subject to priorities 1 and 2

capacity_admission_gate.order: Before the frozen electrical-stress objective priorities, maximize the number of exact-hard-feasible queued whole gangs in the bounded H54 domain; break equal-count ties by least-start-slack EDF order.
capacity_admission_gate.deferred_semantics: A gang that cannot be jointly admitted remains visible and work-conserving in the runtime capacity-blocked queue for the next rolling horizon; it is never dropped and no GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, grid, or deadline constraint is relaxed.
capacity_admission_gate.candidate_truncation_guard: Any selected deferral expands the exact-safe workload candidate set through the approved K grid before deferral is accepted at maximum K.

planning_surrogate_feasibility_semantics.stress_range: The normalized causal radial-surrogate epigraph is reportable above 1.0 and is not clipped at the physical endpoint.
planning_surrogate_feasibility_semantics.reason: Clipping a conservative surrogate at 1.0 converts forecast-model error or a future-horizon warning into solver INFEASIBLE before the exact execution authority can evaluate H0.
planning_surrogate_feasibility_semantics.hard_grid_authority: Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS remains mandatory at every committed H0 action and fails closed on realized voltage, line, or transformer violations.

unchanged_scientific_semantics: Fresh-H0 voltage, line, and transformer acceptance plus planning SOC, PCS, mobility, GPU, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, deadline, and recovery constraints
Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS commit gate
online_commit_chain: bounded 9-stage slow MILP master or exact forced-domain skip
fixed-slow-decision conservative H54 continuous LP recourse

watchdog.stage_allocation: One shared 60-second planner deadline with no stage sub-deadlines. The slow master sees the total remaining deadline; exact recourse receives exactly the wall time left after the master and fixed-decision transfer. Fail closed only when the combined stages exhaust the watchdog.
watchdog.shared_deadline_evidence: R6 issue 1424 failed at the former master partition; R8 issue 1705 then failed at a nominal 20-second master reserve while issue 1704 measured master 16.03 s plus exact recourse 5.16 s, only 22.01 s total. R9 removed stage partitions and proved the combined master-plus-recourse solve itself exceeded 30 seconds. Therefore 30 seconds was a performance target masquerading as a fail-close watchdog, not a defensible physical deadline.
watchdog.watchdog_margin: The 60-second watchdog is one fifth of the physical five-minute control interval, retaining 240 seconds for downstream exact AC, storage, and actuation while allowing January to measure the hard-instance tail. Normal solves terminate at optimality and do not consume the unused allowance.
watchdog.r6_root_cause: The former fixed 55/45 split stopped issue 1424 at the master's 16.5-second sub-deadline even though issue 1423 completed master plus exact recourse in 20.99 seconds and the unchanged total watchdog was 30 seconds.
watchdog.production_freeze_rule: After January development, set the production watchdog from the measured steady-state p99 plus a documented margin; do not use the runtime performance target itself as the timeout
watchdog.semantics: Fail closed on timeout; never relax an objective priority or hard constraint

runtime_acceptance.comparison_scope: Same issue, state, forecast, candidate K, objective, hard constraints, Fresh OpenDSS gate, and storage path; worker/thread topology may vary because it is the measured factor
runtime_acceptance.measured_quantity: End-to-end total issue wall time, with component timings retained
runtime_acceptance.rule: A computational alternative with no paired speed improvement is removed from the production path

latency_accuracy_tradeoff.online_candidate_k_reduction: Base K is 4 for latency; a proven slow-master INFEASIBLE status expands the same issue through K=8 and K=16 so truncation is never misclassified as physical infeasibility
latency_accuracy_tradeoff.circle_approximation: A 16-face inscribed polygon replaces online QCP circles and sacrifices at most 1.921471959676957 percent radial capability while remaining physically conservative
latency_accuracy_tradeoff.native_guard_search_reduction: Online regulator beam width 4 to 2 and maximum depth 16 to 2; unresolved cases still enter continuous safety projection and must pass Fresh OpenDSS or fail closed
retained_fail_closed_gates: Fresh exact three-phase OpenDSS realized-H0 verification

approved_solver_runtime_settings.online_candidate_expansion_evidence: January issue 2069 was INFEASIBLE under both inner-polygon and exact-QCP models at K=4, while the identical checkpoint passed under both models at K=16. Candidate truncation is a latency approximation, not a physical hard limit.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.mobility_route_candidate_policy: Keep workload choices at the latency base K while exposing a destination-balanced causal route prefix of at least K=16 whenever mobility is enabled. The persistent model already reserves the adaptive K=64 route axis, so this does not add model-build memory.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.mobility_candidate_screen_dispatch_domai: Bidirectional active-P probes at plus/minus 100 kW; choosing only discharge reverses location ranking during upper-voltage stress.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.slow_master_gap_evidence: A 3% discrete-master gap admitted STAY while a mobility counterfactual improved predicted worst stress by 2.97%. The 0.1% gap prevents the solver tolerance from erasing the mobility treatment; it does not require movement and STAY remains mandatory.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.persistent_model_refresh_policy: Rebuild both slow-master and recourse Gurobi models after 16 successful solves or any resident job-slot growth. R10 issue 1722 established that retained Gurobi multiobjective numerical state can time out while an identical cold checkpoint passes. R11 then failed issue 1721 after only 25 post-refresh solves under the approved 6-process by 2-thread topology; issue 1720 had already risen to 18.36 s before the next retained solve exceeded 60 s. The 16-solve bound refreshes before the observed 25-solve failure age while amortizing the measured cold build sufficiently to keep steady worker throughput in the 2-second range.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.norm_constraint_scaling: Every line, service-transformer, and PCS P-Q pair is normalized by its physical nameplate. Sixteen regularly spaced halfspaces use apothem R*cos(pi/16), so the complete feasible polygon lies inside the exact physical circle.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.norm_safety_invariant: The paper-facing stress objective remains normalized to physical nameplate. A separate zmax hard cap and PCS hard circle reserve an engineering margin ten times the scale-aware numerical tolerance; even an accepted solution at the positive residual boundary remains strictly inside nameplate because (1 - 1e-5) + 1e-6 < 1.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.exact_norm_fail_closed_audit: Independently evaluate every accepted line, service-transformer, and PCS point against the exact Euclidean circle; any scale-aware residual above the frozen gate fails closed. The inner polygon is conservative and therefore needs no numerical feasibility restoration in normal operation.
approved_solver_runtime_settings.numeric_focus_evidence: Paired 19-step B06 validation reduced steady end-to-end median and p95 with identical route decisions, predicted objectives, Fresh-AC values, zero exact residual, and AC PASS. NumericFocus 0 and 1 remain prohibited for exact recourse after clean reruns exceeded the frozen simultaneous charge/discharge residual tolerance
